name: Autohand
relevance: Terminal coding agent with repository tools and multi-provider model support
notes: Requires Node 22+. Uses the published npm CLI rather than the native installer. The package also publishes agent and ah aliases, which may conflict with other CLIs; detection uses autohand. Configure model providers separately.

name: Serena
relevance: Semantic code retrieval and editing tools for coding agents through MCP
notes: Requires Python 3.11 through 3.14. Set UV_PYTHON=3.13 in the environment when installing to follow the upstream Python 3.13 quick start. Run serena init and choose a language-server or JetBrains backend separately. Language-specific dependencies and MCP client configuration are separate setup steps.

name: OpenViking
relevance: Agent context database with memory, retrieval and resource-management CLIs
notes: Requires Python 3.10+. Published 0.5.0 wheels support macOS arm64 14+/x64 15+, glibc 2.31+ Linux x64/arm64 and Windows x64. This installs the ov client and server tools; initialize a server, configure models and choose agent integrations separately.

name: Context7 CLI
relevance: Retrieves library documentation and configures Context7 access for coding agents
notes: Requires Node 22.13+. The official CLI package and executable are ctx7; this entry does not install the separate @upstash/context7-mcp server. Run ctx7 setup and configure account or agent integrations explicitly.

name: Repomix
relevance: Packs selected repository content into context files for coding agents
notes: Requires Node 22+. Run repomix explicitly in a chosen repository and review its include/exclude configuration before producing or sharing context output. MCP or skill setup is separate.

name: GitIngest
relevance: Converts repositories into text digests for language model context
notes: Requires Python 3.8+. The canonical repository moved to coderamp-labs/gitingest. Select a local path or repository URL and review filters/output before sharing a digest.

name: CrewAI CLI
relevance: Creates, runs and manages multi-agent crews and workflow projects
notes: Requires Python 3.10 through 3.13. Create projects and configure providers separately. Windows source dependency builds may require Visual Studio C++ Build Tools; follow upstream installation guidance.

name: LangGraph CLI
relevance: Scaffolds and operates LangGraph agent applications from the terminal
notes: Requires Python 3.10+. This entry installs the base CLI for project creation and container workflows. Docker is needed for container workflows; langgraph dev requires the optional inmem extra and Python 3.11+ configured separately.

name: Promptfoo
relevance: Evaluates prompts and agent behavior with configurable model and security tests
notes: Requires Node 22.22+. Choose evaluation configurations, model providers and any red-team or hosted integrations explicitly. Installing the CLI does not run evaluations or submit prompts.

name: Inspect AI
relevance: Runs tool-using agent and language model evaluations from the terminal
notes: Requires Python 3.11+. The inspect-ai distribution supplies the inspect CLI. Choose evaluation tasks, model providers and sandbox/container environments separately.

name: E2B CLI
relevance: Manages sandbox templates and environments used to run agent-generated code
notes: Requires Node 22.19+. The CLI package is @e2b/cli, distinct from the e2b SDK. Authenticate and explicitly create or start sandbox resources separately; installation does not provision cloud resources.

name: OpenAgents Launcher
relevance: Terminal launcher and dashboard for managing and connecting coding agents
notes: Requires Node 18+. This entry installs the agn launcher from @openagents-org/agent-launcher, rather than the Python network SDK. Create agent configurations, install runtimes, set credentials and start the daemon explicitly.

name: mcp-use CLI
relevance: Develops, inspects and calls MCP servers and interactive agent tools
notes: Requires Node 22.22.2+. Uses the TypeScript mcp-use package and its CLI dependency, not the similarly named Python SDK. Create projects and configure server connections, authentication or deployment separately.

name: MCP Publisher
relevance: Validates and publishes MCP server metadata to the official registry
notes: Uses the macOS/Linux Homebrew formula. Initialize server metadata and authenticate separately. Publishing is an explicit command; installation does not submit or register a server.

name: MCP Proxy
relevance: Bridges local stdio and remote HTTP/SSE transports for agent MCP clients
notes: Requires Python 3.10+. Choose server commands or URLs, authentication and transport/listener settings explicitly. Installation does not start a proxy or connect an MCP server.

name: MCP Remote
relevance: Connects local MCP clients to remote servers with OAuth support
notes: Requires Node 20.18.1+ for its Undici 7 dependency; the upstream README still describes Node 18+. The canonical repository is punkpeye/mcp-remote. Configure server URLs and OAuth/client settings separately; installation does not start a connection.

name: Ollama CLI
relevance: Runs and serves local language models for coding agents and developer tools
notes: Uses the macOS/Linux Homebrew CLI formula. Start the local server and download/select models explicitly. Installing this entry does not enable a background service or download models; hardware support varies by backend.

name: llama.cpp CLI
relevance: Local model inference and OpenAI-compatible serving tools for agent workflows
notes: Uses the macOS/Linux Homebrew formula, including llama-cli and llama-server. Choose compatible GGUF models and start inference or serving explicitly. GPU/backend availability depends on platform and hardware.

name: MarkItDown
relevance: Converts documents and structured files into Markdown for agent context
notes: Requires Python 3.10 through 3.14. Installs the base CLI. Additional file formats require optional extras and sometimes system converters; configure those separately per upstream guidance. Choose input files and output explicitly.

name: Crawl4AI CLI
relevance: Crawls web content into structured text and Markdown for agent retrieval
notes: Requires Python 3.10+. The crawl4ai package supplies crwl. Browser downloads, system libraries and crawl4ai-setup are separate explicit steps; review upstream prerequisites for each platform before crawling.
